mapper.select: SELECT , , , FROM payment p LEFT JOIN fairs f ON f.fair_id = p.fair_id LEFT JOIN business b ON b.business_id = p.business_id LEFT JOIN application_form af ON af.application_id = p.application_id LEFT JOIN refund r ON r.payment_id = p.payment_id WHERE p.payment_id = #{paymentId}
SELECT FROM payment WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM payment WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId} AND payment_type = 'RESERVATION_DEPOSIT'
SELECT FROM payment WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} AND payment_type = 'VENDOR_FEE'
mapper.update: UPDATE payment SET status = 'COMPLETED', method = #{method}, toss_payment_key = #{tossPaymentKey}, easy_pay_provider = #{easyPayProvider}, paid_at = #{paidAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId} AND status = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE payment SET status = 'WAITING_FOR_DEPOSIT', method = #{method}, toss_payment_key = #{tossPaymentKey}, virtual_account_bank_code = #{virtualAccountBankCode}, virtual_account_number = #{virtualAccountNumber}, virtual_account_due_date = #{virtualAccountDueDate}, virtual_account_secret = #{virtualAccountSecret}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId} AND status = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE payment SET status = 'PENDING', amount = #{amount}, order_id = #{orderId}, method = 'TOSS', toss_payment_key = NULL, paid_at = NULL, easy_pay_provider = NULL, virtual_account_bank_code = NULL, virtual_account_number = NULL, virtual_account_due_date = NULL, virtual_account_secret = NULL, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId} AND status IN ('FAILED', 'CANCELED', 'EXPIRED')
mapper.select: SELECT FROM payment WHERE fair_id = #{fairId} AND business_id = #{businessId} AND payment_type = 'VENDOR_FEE' AND status = 'COMPLETED' FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM payment WHERE fair_id = #{fairId} AND payment_type = 'VENDOR_FEE' AND status = 'COMPLETED' FOR UPDATE

SELECT , , , FROM payment p LEFT JOIN fairs f ON f.fair_id = p.fair_id LEFT JOIN business b ON b.business_id = p.business_id LEFT JOIN application_form af ON af.application_id = p.application_id LEFT JOIN refund r ON r.payment_id = p.payment_id
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.payment_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT f.fair_id AS fair_id , f.name AS fair_name , COALESCE(ticket.amount, 0) AS ticket_amount , COALESCE(vendor_fee.amount, 0) AS vendor_fee_amount FROM fairs f LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.fair_id, SUM(p.amount - COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0)) AS amount FROM payment p LEFT JOIN refund r ON r.payment_id = p.payment_id AND r.status = 'COMPLETED' WHERE p.payment_type = 'RESERVATION_DEPOSIT' AND p.status = 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY p.fair_id ) ticket ON ticket.fair_id = f.fair_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.fair_id, SUM(p.amount - COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0)) AS amount FROM payment p LEFT JOIN refund r ON r.payment_id = p.payment_id AND r.status = 'COMPLETED' WHERE p.payment_type = 'VENDOR_FEE' AND p.status = 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY p.fair_id ) vendor_fee ON vendor_fee.fair_id = f.fair_id ORDER BY f.fair_id DESC

SELECT f.fair_id AS fair_id , f.name AS fair_name , COALESCE(ticket.amount, 0) AS ticket_amount , COALESCE(vendor_fee.amount, 0) AS vendor_fee_amount FROM fairs f LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.fair_id, SUM(p.amount - COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0)) AS amount FROM payment p LEFT JOIN refund r ON r.payment_id = p.payment_id AND r.status = 'COMPLETED' WHERE p.payment_type = 'RESERVATION_DEPOSIT' AND p.status = 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY p.fair_id ) ticket ON ticket.fair_id = f.fair_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.fair_id, SUM(p.amount - COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0)) AS amount FROM payment p LEFT JOIN refund r ON r.payment_id = p.payment_id AND r.status = 'COMPLETED' WHERE p.payment_type = 'VENDOR_FEE' AND p.status = 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY p.fair_id ) vendor_fee ON vendor_fee.fair_id = f.fair_id WHERE f.fair_id = #{fairId}
